items.question: According to this retailer's return policy, within how many days will a refund be credited to the customer's card, bank account, PayPal or Tabby account after the returns are checked?
items.fact: Online return refunds credited within 4-15 days to original payment method

items.question: Can Iconic products be returned to any store of this retailer, or only to an Iconic store?
items.gold: Iconic products can only be returned to an Iconic store.
items.fact: Iconic products returnable only at Iconic stores
